meta.revisionPolicy: Survey estimates are final on release.
meta.coverage: All India; quarterly ASUSE bulletin (from Jan–Mar 2025), by sector and by broad activity as published
meta.note: Calendar quarters plotted at quarter start. Establishment/worker counts are in hundreds ('00) as published; the rest are percentages. The quarterly bulletin is a separate short series and is never joined to the annual rounds.
